github.title: 4-Stage PCS Epoch Budget Design
github.body:
## 4-Stage PCS Epoch Budget Design

### Summary
Replace the current single-stage PCS (Participant Credit Score) with a **4-stage progressive loyalty pipeline** (Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum) where each stage has its own epoch budget allocation curve.

### Current Behaviour (M2/M3 P0)
PCS is calculated as a single score per cohort. Tier thresholds exist (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum) but only modify the Settlement Ratio via a flat multiplier. The epoch budget is distributed proportionally by PCS score regardless of tier.

### Target Behaviour
- Each tier gets a **dedicated budget allocation** from the per-epoch ACR budget
- Higher tiers receive disproportionately larger allocations (reward loyalty)
- Tier advancement gates ensure users can't game their way to Platinum in a few epochs
- Budget curves can be calibrated independently per tier to tune incentive gradients

### Tokenomics Persona Obligations
- **Emissions Schedule:** How the epoch budget distributes across tiers (e.g., 40% Bronze, 25% Silver, 20% Gold, 15% Platinum)
- **Vesting/Unlock Alignment:** Tier advancement gates must align with vesting schedules
- **Incentive Source:** Which pool funds tier bonuses — AR or a separate allocation?
- **Assumptions Challenge:** Are tier thresholds correctly calibrated to prevent gaming or premature tier inflation?

### Story
- US-Z1-M3-09: 4-stage PCS with epoch budget

---
